trigger: Repeated repository repairs replaced or demoted intended capability with bounded local/synthetic/proof-only surfaces instead of preserving and completing the intended product capability.
controlling_invariant: The approved product capability is the unit of completion. Proof, governance, truth-boundary, and repository-excellence mechanisms must verify and strengthen capability; they must not become substitutes for capability or reasons to remove it.
emergency_rules: WHEN_A CLAIM_OUTRUNS IMPLEMENTATION_BUILD_THE MISSING IMPLEMENTATION; DO_NOT DEFAULT TO SHRINKING THE PRODUCT
suspect_change_classes: truth-harden commits that replace broader architecture with local or synthetic-only mechanisms
promotion demotions that became permanent product ceilings
removal of MCP/mesh/provider/runtime/external-effect paths rather than completing or safely gating them
replacement of autonomous or operational mechanisms with report/receipt/proposal-only behavior
scaffold convergence that deleted unique experimental mechanisms without donor extraction
generic capability replacement where the removed label corresponded to an unfinished but intended mechanism rather than empty marketing
recovery_protocol: For each active canonical repository, identify the strongest pre-neutralization capability state from repository history and estate trajectory receipts.
Diff that state against current canonical head at code-path, package, CLI/API, runtime, connector, workflow, deployment, and machine-contract levels.
Classify every removed or disabled capability as unsupported-claim-only, duplicated, unsafe-unbounded, or real-capability-regression.
Restore real-capability regressions onto a fresh current-head branch while preserving later bug fixes, tests, provenance, and security improvements.
Where the old implementation was incomplete, finish it instead of deleting it or redefining the product downward.
Keep truthful non-affiliation and evidence boundaries in public projections without using them as implementation ceilings.
Require exact-head deterministic, adversarial, runtime, and deployment proof as applicable after restoration.

Close each repository only when current canonical capability is at least as strong as the strongest legitimate prior capability state and the next evolution cursor increases power rather than narrows it.
evidence_examples: spacex-mission-control: live flight/command/voice/MCP/mesh claims replaced with synthetic operations proof
spacex-telemetry: throughput/flight-control/MCP/mesh claims replaced with synthetic codec proof
spacex-orbital-mechanics: Lambert/N-body/high-precision/flight-agent/MCP/mesh paths removed from current product boundary
xai-colossus-2: autonomous control claims replaced with evidence receipt routing
xai-colossus-security: security behavior bounded to non-executing response proposals
colossus-gateway: broader architecture preserved only as historical/aspirational while current product reduced to MCP stdio behavior
next_cursor: Build an estate-wide capability regression matrix from pre-neutralization checkpoints versus current canonical heads; restore one highest-value real capability regression end-to-end before resuming ordinary excellence waves.
